events.event: Kemenhub says haze from karhutla disrupted 3,030 flights between 14 Aug and 25 Oct 2026, with about 1,700 (56%) cancelled, while stating no airport was closed.
events.key_numbers: 3,030 flights disrupted · ~1,700 cancelled (56%) · 154 routes · 14 Aug-25 Oct 2026 · earlier tally 2,458 flights at 29 airports (to 17 Oct)
events.why_it_matters: Haze is now costing travellers thousands of cancelled flights, just before the Nataru travel season.
events.spreading_evidence: CNBC Indonesia news list (top 15, 27 Oct); multiple regional outlets

events.event: Malaysia offers Indonesia one CL-415MP amphibious aircraft, one Mi-171 helicopter and 44 personnel to fight karhutla, discussed with BNPB head Kristomei Sianturi; Indonesia keeps operational control.
events.key_numbers: 1 amphibious aircraft · 1 helicopter · 44 personnel · earlier offer: CL-415MP + 3 helicopters + 50 personnel (undated) · national response 71,878 ground personnel and 63 air assets as of 25 Oct
events.why_it_matters: The country whose air is being choked by Indonesian haze is now offering to help put the fires out.

events.event: A Bogor-bound KRL at Jakarta Kota station emitted white smoke and a loud bang, reported by KAI to be caused by the pantograph; passengers panicked and ran, and videos went viral.
events.key_numbers: ~19:55 WIB 27 Oct (article timestamp) · no casualties reported · cause per KAI: pantograf (final inspection pending)
events.why_it_matters: Millions of Jabodetabek commuters ride KRL daily, and it follows reports of overcrowding and cancelled trips.
events.spreading_evidence: Viral videos on social media per CNN Indonesia, Detik, iNews, IDN Times; CNN nasional list

events.event: A viral video shows a towing truck carrying a car at a Tol Cipali gate told to tap two toll cards; Tol Cipali operator apologised, said towing trucks pay only by their own vehicle class, and cited a gate-officer identification mismatch.
events.key_numbers: Rule: toll charged by towing truck's class, nothing for the carried car · fare amounts not reported
events.why_it_matters: Motorists can be wrongly charged at toll gates and should know the actual rule.
events.spreading_evidence: Viral video; CNN Indonesia nasional list, Detik berita

events.event: Government sets 11-13% discount on domestic economy airfares for Nataru via a 100% government-borne VAT (PPN DTP) on base fare and fuel surcharge.
events.key_numbers: 11-13% discount · Rp722 billion budget · ~3.7 million passengers · flights 22 Dec 2026-10 Jan 2027 · tickets bought 20 Oct 2026-10 Jan 2027 (per CNBC)
events.why_it_matters: Cheaper Christmas and New Year flights, but only the VAT part is discounted, so the saving is limited.
events.spreading_evidence: CNBC Indonesia news list; covered by CNN, Suara, Investor.id, Bloomberg Technoz

events.event: DKI Jakarta and Bekasi city extend the Bantargebang waste-site cooperation by five years, signed by Governor Pramono Anung and Mayor Tri Adhianto, with Jakarta contributing about Rp362 billion.
events.key_numbers: 5-year extension · ~Rp362 billion · signed 26 Oct 2026 · ~4,000 (unit unstated, presumably tons) of waste going to Bantargebang
events.why_it_matters: Jakarta's waste still depends on one landfill in Bekasi, and the cost to keep it open is large.

events.event: A Tangerang mechanic, Yudariansyah, was billed for two years of vehicle tax on a McLaren 570S (B-570-H) registered in his name; Samsat Ciledug found he does not own it and blocked the data on 24 Oct.
events.key_numbers: Rp137.4 million tax arrears (per Medcom, Kumparan; Detik says 'hundreds of millions') · 2 years unpaid · address checked 23 Oct · data blocked 24 Oct
events.why_it_matters: Anyone's identity can be used to register a vehicle, so people should check their own registered data.

events.event: Police and DPR react to alleged bullying of 13 female students at SMPN 10 Ciputat (Tangsel), who were reportedly forced by senior students to drink a coffee-vinegar mix after losing 'challenges'; 3 were hospitalised.
events.key_numbers: 13 victims · 3 hospitalised (stomach pain) · police comment 24 Oct · no suspect named in sources read
events.why_it_matters: School bullying keeps escalating to physical harm, and parents want to know what schools and police must do.
